_comment: Historical synthetic-demo configuration. The Phase 02 training gate rejects this manifest for final claims.
experiment_description: Phase 02 lightweight UNet baseline, random init, BCE+Dice loss, no pretrained weights.

preprocessing._normalize_note: ImageNet statistics used as a conventional starting point even without pretrained weights.

augmentation._note: Train-only augmentations. Val/test use no augmentation. Transforms are applied consistently to image and mask.

model._rationale: Random initialization. Pretrained weights deferred to Phase 03 for clean improvement attribution.

loss.name: BCEDiceLoss
loss._rationale: Combined BCE+Dice handles foreground/background imbalance (~15% foreground). Dice is differentiable and directly related to the primary evaluation metric.

training._optimizer_rationale: Adam is chosen for its adaptive learning rate — reliable default for small medical datasets without extensive tuning.
training._batch_size_note: Batch size 2 selected for CPU memory constraints. Larger batches would require GPU.
training._epoch_note: 20 epochs is sufficient to observe convergence trends on 14 training samples. Overfitting expected and documented.

checkpointing._resume_note: Resume not implemented for this baseline — training is short enough that full rerun from scratch is practical.

evaluation._aggregation: Macro-average across test samples (mean of per-sample scores).

device._note: Will use CUDA if available, CPU otherwise. Training validated on CPU.
